viewport.units: authored SVG canvas, not a breakpoint

local_dimensions.canvas: 1200×720 authored fixture only; sizes and timings are not global tokens

alpha_masters.note: V3.4.1 compositing variants. Opaque pixels are byte-identical to the ratified masters above; only the authored dark field is carried as alpha. The edge pixels carry straight (unmatted) alpha: the subject colour at partial coverage, not a blend of the subject with the removed field. Compositing over the authored field reproduces the ratified master exactly; compositing over any other neutral substrate must never darken the edge.
alpha_masters.reason: The dark faces of all three cubes sit close to Anthracite. Over a chromatic substrate they collapse into the brand hue and the dark-face assignment protected by ID-001 is lost.

annotations: The three packaged PNG files are ratified visual masters; do not regenerate them from tokens.
Semantic color-family tokens remain available for interface projections, but material artwork contains authored local modulation.
Cube symbols are image content, not live interface typography.
The composite reference sheet may show all three masters together; each distributable identity master remains one cube per asset.
Reference SVG embeds the packaged Space Grotesk WOFF2 for metadata labels only.
V3.4.1 ships one alpha compositing variant per identity. These are the same artwork, not a new master; ID-004 sanctions them on neutral substrates only.
An alpha master is a substrate decision, not a licence to transform the mark. ID-003 still forbids perspective, re-lighting and geometric normalisation of any master.
